offer_top-half_likely: A quiet start: the board take you at your word and wait.
offer_top-half_downside: Little to lose and little to gain from the promise itself.
offer_promotion_likely: A bold pitch: the board back it with budget and a target to match.
offer_promotion_downside: They will hold you to it: a slow start reads as a broken promise.
offer_stability_likely: A modest pitch: less budget, a gentle target, patience bought.
offer_stability_downside: An ambitious owner hears it as a lack of it.
offer_decline_likely: Nothing changes: your agent keeps applying.
offer_decline_downside: The next offer may be a smaller club, or a longer wait.
approach_accept_likely: A bigger club and a fresh start: "in demand" on your record.
approach_accept_downside: A new board's welcome is a roll: some start cold.
approach_decline_likely: Credit and loyalty here: the board notice who stayed.
approach_decline_downside: The call may not come again.
mutualConsent_accept_likely: Half the contract paid up and a small mark on the record.
mutualConsent_accept_downside: The market still sees a manager who left early.
mutualConsent_decline_likely: You fight on: a run of results could turn it.
mutualConsent_decline_downside: A sacking, the bigger mark, if the results do not come.
renewal_accept_likely: Two more years; the board have said they want you.
renewal_accept_downside: A better job may call while you are tied here.
renewal_decline_likely: Your contract runs out and you leave with nothing owed and a free hand.
renewal_decline_downside: The market may read it as drifting; the next job is not promised.
fallout_back-down_likely: He stays, and the room loses a little heart.
fallout_back-down_downside: Once seen to back down, the next player tries it too.
fallout_sell_likely: He goes; the side is weaker and more yours.
fallout_sell_downside: A room that liked him turns; one that did not breathes out.
summerWindow_spend_likely: The budget goes on senior players; the squad steps up.
summerWindow_spend_downside: Signings arrive as a bet each; the board reset the target upward.
summerWindow_rebuild_likely: Money and the academy together: the biggest turnover, the freshest side.
summerWindow_rebuild_downside: A new side takes time to gel; your standing resets with it.
summerWindow_youth_likely: Half the budget and the academy promoted: cheap, slow, yours.
summerWindow_youth_downside: The season starts with kids in the eleven.
summerWindow_sell_likely: Cash in on a senior player: money in, strength down, more of the XI yours.
summerWindow_sell_downside: The table does not care whose side it is.
summerWindow_hold_likely: Nothing moves; the squad you have is the squad you get.
summerWindow_hold_downside: Rivals strengthen and you stand still.
winterWindow_spend_likely: A small pot spent on a top-up.
winterWindow_spend_downside: A winter signing is a rush job.
press_confident_likely: The room lifts on the front page.
press_confident_downside: Or it sounds like bluster and the room hears it.
press_defiant_likely: The room rallies behind a manager under fire.
press_defiant_downside: Or it reads as blame, and the room takes it personally.
board_accept_likely: Take it on the chin; nothing moves.
board_accept_downside: The next bad month arrives with the same warning.
board_pushBack_downside: Some do not, and the credit goes the other way.
board_promise_downside: The target is a place harder, and a promise unkept is remembered.
activity_wait_likely: Your name stays in play for the next vacancy.
activity_wait_downside: The phone stays quiet, and the slide goes on.
activity_punditry_likely: Half the slide, a little income, your face on television.
activity_punditry_downside: Boards remember the pundit, not the manager.
activity_assistant_likely: The slide stops; the income is steady.
activity_assistant_downside: Stepping down costs reputation once, and it is on the record.
newDeal_accept_likely: He signs, happy; the wage bill rises.
newDeal_refuse_likely: He is unhappy, and the room notices.
newDeal_refuse_downside: Or he knuckles down; or he sulks, and the room takes his side.
wantsAway_keep_likely: He stays, unhappy; the side keeps its depth.
wantsAway_keep_downside: An unhappy player does not play like a happy one.
wantsAway_sell_likely: A fee into the club's cash; his place opens up.
wantsAway_sell_downside: The room may miss him; or it may breathe easier.
playerContract_renew_likely: He stays on the terms he asked; the assistant agrees.
playerContract_renew_downside: Wages for a player who may be past it.
playerContract_release_likely: He goes in the summer; the wage bill falls.
playerContract_release_downside: A hole in the squad and a friend gone from the room.
selection_upgrade_likely: A better player in: the side is stronger for it.
selection_upgrade_downside: Little; the one going off may sulk.
selection_downgrade_likely: Fresh legs at a small cost in quality.
selection_downgrade_downside: The gap in rating shows against a good side.
selection_tired_downside: Tired legs get hurt, and get caught.
selection_debut_likely: A debut: a point toward a player made.
selection_debut_downside: A kid can freeze; the result carries the risk.
